name: Áaron
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Gym Desk
Subject: Mat storage
Áaron booked the van for tuesday, the old mats by the mirror must go before the friday delivery.

name: Williams
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Transport
Subject: Route 12 detour
The bridge closure adds fifteen minutes to the school run, so the morning pickups move earlier. Williams has reprinted the cards and the drivers have been briefed. Old times stay up until friday.

name: Werneburg Mohabak
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Conference Office
Subject: Delegate packs
Two hundred lanyards arrived with the wrong clips and the printed programme has last years room numbers. Werneburg Mohabak has rechecked the sheet and sent the corrections to the printer, and the clip supplier is sending a replacement box by courier. Everything else for the packs is bagged and ready.

name: Titirca Klingenböck
text:
Fwd: Air con fault
The upstairs unit is tripping the breaker again. Titirca Klingenböck has the log from the last visit and will meet the engineer on thursday morning.

name: Iphigénie
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Membership
Subject: Locker audit
Fourteen lockers are listed as vacant but the keys are missing. Iphigénie found the spares mixed in with the old fobs, and the audit sheet will be corrected before the insurance renewal goes out.

name: Baierlipp
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Grounds
Subject: Tree survey
The arborist report flagged two limes by the east path for crown reduction and one ash that needs felling before the nesting season. Baierlipp has marked the trees with tape and booked the chipper for the last week of the month. The path stays open while the crew works.

name: De Mari
text:
Forwarded from Reception
Subject: Taxi booking
De Mari has the key safe code for the airport run at five, the desk locks up once the driver signs out.

name: Gheorghita Katsue
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Nursery
Subject: Fence panels
Two panels by the sandpit came loose in the storm and the gap is wider than it looks. Gheorghita Katsue taped the area off this morning and the joiner will rehang both panels on saturday.

name: Keani
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Sports Centre
Subject: Pool hoist service
The hoist has failed its daily check twice this week and the reps can only come in august, which is too late for the disability swim club. Keani has asked the manufacturer for an emergency slot and lined up a loan hoist from the sister site as cover.

name: Medjitna
text:
Fwd: Barrier cards
The old barrier cards stop working friday and the new stack is in the safe. Medjitna will swap them at the gate from monday.

name: Somadina Bustillo Cefan
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Estates
Subject: Window restrictors
The upper floor windows fail the opening limit check in three rooms. Somadina Bustillo Cefan has ordered the replacement arms and the fitter will work room by room so the offices stay usable.

name: Nawfal Cuinet Bombana
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Waste Services
Subject: Trade bin contract
The collection days change to tuesday and friday from the first of the month and the bins must be at the kerb by six. Nawfal Cuinet Bombana has updated the site calendar and the duty list shows who wheels them out on each shift.

name: Aaruth
text:
Hedge cutting review, 4 May
Two meters came off the north border without wear. Aaruth flagged the guard bolt and the workshop will fit the replacement on friday.

name: Noreisch
text:
Volunteer rota, 12 June
Eight of the weekend slots are still open and the planting day is close. Noreisch has emailed the two groups that helped in spring and will ring the library list tomorrow. Badge packs are ready at the desk.

name: Udayakumar Ramires
text:
Security review, 8 July
Gate camera two has been offline since the firmware push, so the blind spot at the fuel bay is back. Udayakumar Ramires logged a case with the vendor and set a daily walk of the perimeter until it is fixed. The badge reader on the west door was also upgraded while the engineer was on site.

name: von Steegen
text:
Kitchen briefing, 15 September
Two fryer baskets have loose handles. von Steegen ordered replacements and the old ones stay in the store until they arrive.

name: Arbër
text:
Overdue jobs review, 2 October
Three tickets passed their target dates this week, two for parts and one for access. Arbër chased the supplier on the motor mounts and the tenant on the meter room key. Both are promised by monday.

name: Boecker
text:
Insurance walk, 9 November
The assessor found the fire door on the mezzanine propped open and the extinguisher by the server room missing its tag. Boecker photographed both and sent the fix evidence the same afternoon, and the door closer was adjusted while the visit was still going. A follow up letter is expected but no penalty is proposed.

name: Al Karah
text:
Stock meeting, 18 December
Four pallets of tile adhesive are still on the yard. Al Karah moved them under cover and the count is now correct.

name: Phal Miron Kösem
text:
Staff forum, 21 January
The water coolers are being swapped for plumbed units and the first fit is booked for the west wing. Phal Miron Kösem collected the questions from the floor and will post answers by the end of the week.

name: Alka
text:
Budget meeting, 3 February
The winter fuel figure came in eighteen per cent over and the reserve will not cover it without dipping into the roof fund. Alka has asked each site to submit its meter readings again so the supplier can be challenged line by line, and the finance team will model the two options before the vote.

name: Varghese
text:
Grounds meeting, 17 March
Two hornbeam saplings did not take and the nursery will replace them. Varghese marked the gaps with canes today.

name: Basteiro Haylegergish
text:
Cleaning contract review, 8 April
The east block scored under target on the audit and the washroom checks were logged late three times. Basteiro Haylegergish walked the site with the contractor and agreed a retraining day for the team.

name: Vujica Enoch
text:
Fleet review, 15 May
Three vans are due their safety inspections in the same week and the hire cover will eat most of the maintenance float. Vujica Enoch has staggered two of the bookings and moved the tyre replacement to june so the budget still balances. The hire firm will hold one van on standby at no cost.

name: Georgian
text:
Fwd: Ventilation fault
The drying room fan stopped overnight and the room stayed damp. The unit needs a new motor and the quote came back high, passed to Georgian

name: Fisler
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Depot
Subject: Tacho downloads
The card downloads failed for two drivers on friday and the analysis software flagged the gap. Both cards were retried from the office terminal and the records are complete again, the audit note goes to Fisler

name: Zopito Märki-Gasser
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Finance
Subject: Year end accruals
The late invoices kept arriving after the cut off and three of them belong to last years budget, which changes the variance line. The schedule has been rebuilt and the entries are waiting for approval, so any questions before the run should go to Zopito Märki-Gasser

name: Domas Tinet
text:
Fwd: Sample fridge
The alarm log shows two door openings after midnight and the seals were checked and look fine. The overnight panel was left to Domas Tinet

name: Olexandr
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Procurement
Subject: Helmet order
The replacement helmets arrived in the wrong colour and the supplier will only swap unopened boxes, but two were already in use. The team keeps the old sets and the exchange paperwork is with Olexandr

name: Gualzata
text:
Forwarded from the ranger team
Subject: Path closure
The riverside path floods below the second weir and the boardwalk is under water, so the closure notice is going up tonight. The meadow diversion adds twenty minutes and the far gate needs unlocking, the key is with the volunteers. The works team will check the bank, updates go to Gualzata

name: Sojanovic Brush
text:
Fwd: Cycle shelter
The rack bolts worked loose again and one hoop is leaning, so the whole run needs re-setting. The quote is with Sojanovic Brush

name: Reitamo Trecenti Bardel
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Ticket Office
Subject: Concession renewals
The under sixteen passes need proof of age and the desk cannot process them without it. Letters have gone out and the batch of returns is being checked, any disputes go to Reitamo Trecenti Bardel

name: Wanderson
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Training
Subject: Defib refresher
Six staff are overdue their defibrillator refresher and the certificate for two of them runs out at the end of the month. Two dates have been offered and the sign up sheet is on the board, late bookings will need to go through Wanderson

name: Ucha
text:
Fwd: Floodlight timer
The court lights switch off at nine instead of ten and the club nights run later, so the timer needs resetting. The code is held by Ucha

name: Angiolina Cathleen Royale
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Pool
Subject: Lane booking
The club block on sunday mornings is cut to four lanes for the gala training, and the coach wants the third lane kept for the juniors. Queries go to Angiolina Cathleen Royale

name: Finya Alberga Locanto
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Heritage Group
Subject: Display case
The case by the stairs keeps misting up because the door seal has hardened and the documents inside have started to curl. A dehumidifier pack is in as a stopgap while the cabinet maker quotes for a new seal, the loan agreement for the letters is with Finya Alberga Locanto

name: Plader
text:
Fwd: Meter reading
The submeter for the workshop hasnt been read since march and the bill is estimated. Access is booked for tuesday, the form goes to Plader

name: Jean-Joel
text:
Marketing sync, 6 May
The spring campaign pulled in twice the sign ups we forecast. The budget line for the printed flyers is unspent, so that money moves to the radio spots, sign off on the swap goes to Jean-Joel

name: Krylov
text:
Production planning, 19 June
The mould changeover for the new casing ran four hours over because the pre-heat schedule was never printed, which pushed the night run back and cost one lorry slot. The schedule for july is being rebuilt with wider changeover windows and the warm-up steps are posted at the press. The revised plan is filed with Krylov

name: Celian Tilbe
text:
Tree group meeting, 3 July
Two diseased cherries will be felled next week and the wood is going to the Men's Shed, the arborist report goes to Celian Tilbe

name: Yakha Perpetue
text:
Events debrief, 12 August
The summer fete beat the charity target by four hundred and the stallholders have asked for the same pitches next year. The survey summary and the thank you list go to Yakha Perpetue

name: Minh
text:
Safety forum, 2 September
The near miss on the east scaffold was caused by a missing toe board and the subbie has been stood down from height work until the toolbox talk is redone. The revised permit rules start monday, the action list is held by Minh

name: Rasia
text:
Room bookings group, 21 October
The studio double booking on fridays is resolved and the deposit box moves to the desk, the new grid goes to Rasia

name: Mira Sizana
text:
Health and safety huddle, 5 November
Two of the new hi-vis vests failed the reflective test and the supplier is replacing the batch free of charge. The refresher dates for the manual handling course are going on the board, bookings go to Mira Sizana

name: Gusberti Dell'oso
text:
Annual general meeting, 8 December
The accounts were approved with one abstention and the subscription stays at the same level. Two committee seats were filled without a vote and the third goes to a ballot in january. The hall hire invoice was queried and the treasurer will bring the paperwork to the next meeting. Minutes go to Gusberti Dell'oso

name: Besim
text:
Garden volunteers, 9 January
Four raised beds need new timber edging before spring and the compost bay is full, the order list goes to Besim

name: Reithmayer
text:
Admin team catch up, 20 February
The new filing system starts monday and the old folders stay in the strong room for six months before shredding. Visitor forms are going digital and the paper stock runs down first. The summary goes to Reithmayer

name: Kuwabara-Wagg Bolanyig Adanledji
text:
Partnership review, 14 March
The mentoring scheme matched nine pairs this term and the feedback scores are the best since the pilot. The funding bid for the second year has gone in and the outcome lands in may. Two host companies asked to double their places, the draft programme goes to Kuwabara-Wagg Bolanyig Adanledji

name: Vidak Gerloff
text:
Pitch inspection, 6 April
The goalposts passed the safety check and the drain by the corner flag was cleared, the report goes to Vidak Gerloff

name: Sou
text:
Rent arrears panel, 18 May
Six cases were reviewed and four repayment plans were agreed without escalation. The two remaining tenants have been offered support sessions and the housing officer will visit both homes. No eviction notices were issued, the case files go to Sou
